senses.gloss:
रभ् रभ् (originally = ग्रभ्, लभ्), i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry and Man. also Par., Man. 7, 59).
 1. † To desire vehemently.
 2. † To act inconsiderately.
 3. To seize, to take (ved.).
 --With the prep. आ आ, To begin, Man. 7, 299. []
 2. To act strenuously, Bhaṭṭ. 3, 7.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. आरब्ध.
 1. Began, done; रहस्य् आरब्धा कथा, A secret conversation, Vikr. d. 51.
 2. Having begun, MBh. 1, 7660.
 --Absol. आरभ्य, From. Hit. 91, 21.
 --With अन्वा अनु-आ, To get back, Rām. 2, 64, 60.
 --With अभ्या अभि-आ, To begin, MBh. 3, 10724 (Par.).
 --With प्रा प्र-आ, To begin, Bhag. 18, 15; Pañc. iii. d. 130. प्रारब्ध, n. An attempt, enterprise, Lass. 1, 6.
 --With समा सम्-आ,
 1. To begin, Rām. 1, 45, 13, to undertake, Hit. 44, 6, M.M.
 2. To try, MBh. 1, 2238.
 3. To treat, MBh. 3, 16298.
 --With परि परि, To embrace, Vikr. d. 147; MBh. 4, 514. Desider. परि रिप्स, To desire to embrace, Ragh. 13, 32 (Calc.).
 --With सम् सम्, संरब्ध,
 1. Exasperated, enraged, Rām. 2, 55, 30.
 2. Agitated, overwhelmed, Nal. 13, 14.
 --Comp.
 --With अभिसम् अभि-सम्, अभिसंरब्ध, Enraged, Rām. 6, 3, 17.
 --Cf. Lat. rabies, robur (labor, see लभ्); probably ῥωβίδας, ῥώννυμι; Goth. arbaiths; A.S. earfedh, earfodh; Goth. liban; A.S. leofian, lifian, lybban; O.H.G. laba, labôn; perhaps A.S. a-refian, To bear, a-raefnan, To take away.

रभस् रभ् + अस्, n. ved.
 1. Zeal (in रभस् + वन्त्, zealous, Rigv. i. 9, 6).
 2. Strength, strengthening food, sacrifice, Rigv. i. 145, 3. See रभ्.

रभस रभस् + अ,
 I. adj. Joyful, Kir. 5, 1.
 II. m.
 1. Joy.
 2. Passion, rage, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 8.
 3. Speed, velocity, Śiś. 9, 72; abl. quickly, Rājat. 5, 190.
 4. Precipitation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 315.
 5. Regret, sorrow.
 --Comp.
राभस्य राभस्य, i. e. रभस + अ, n. The state or condition of velocity, or of joy.
